# :x: DO NOT USE SIGN-IN IS BROKEN ON 0.6.4 AND BEFORE


## Build Info

Built at (UTC): `Wed Sep 09 17:59:46 2026`
Built at (UTC date): `2026-09-09`
Commit SHA: `f93a95c079057090bea355453ef24f6e8668dfa9`
Version: `0.6.4`

#### What's Changed:
- **Developer Portal in Settings**: Manage your Apple Developer App IDs, Provisioning Profiles, Certificates, Devices, and App Groups directly inside the app for both paid and free team types.
- **Manual Profile Creation**: Paid developer accounts can now create manual profiles on app without having to reach developer portal.
- **Certificate Management**: Certificate CSR + create/revoke in developer portal, export, import, view all data including ASN1, keys, and much more metadata.
- **Full Two-Factor Authentication**: Added support for SMS verification, Voice phone call in addition to trusted devices during login 2FA Challenge.
- **Cellular Refresh**: Now one can enable cellular refresh with shortcuts to refresh on the go without waiting for wifi anytime anywhere (credits to @spidy123222)
- **Health Check**: Newer dedicated Health Check section in settings to diagnose device and network communication issues quickly.
- **On-Device Anisette**: Switched to on-device anisette data generation as the primary anisette data source of OTP requests during 2FA. No more need for Remote anisette servers.
- **App & Mach-O Inspector**: Inspect any app's internal files, Mach-O binaries, and embedded provisioning profiles right from App Info.
- **Storage Explorer**: Full view of all storage managed by the app and its sideloaded apps including caches, appgroups, tmp dirs, private documents dir etc.
- **Faster VPN peer auto-discovery**: Parallel connection probing discovers your device on the local vpn network much faster by doing a parallel probe for device services like lockdown/rppairing ports.
- **Dual Connection Modes**: Switch between LocalDevVPN/WireGuard and Remote servers as for loopback as required.
- **Account Config Export**: Export and import your accounts and sources as `.sideconf` files for quick setup or migration.
- **Full Liquid-Glass support**: Added smooth pill buttons, improved scroll animations, and fixed UI flickering in the My Apps tab.

#### ⚠️Known Issue
- iOS 16 users may have difficulty connecting to LocalDevVPN and is being actively worked on.

#### Full Changelog: [0.6.3...0.6.4](https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/239fc7c2b7f3c319d3608bd49c30d1457216d5df...f93a95c079057090bea355453ef24f6e8668dfa9)

## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (macOS) **Smoother displays**: VMs now follow your display's refresh rate, so motion is fluid at up to 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.
* **More reliable USB**: Fast external SSDs can now be shared with a VM, and disconnecting a drive no longer freezes UTM. On macOS, drives are safely unmounted before they are handed to a VM.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* (macOS) Check out [UTM Games Database](https://db.getutm.app/) to see and report game compatibility for the experimental 3D driver. Re-install the Windows guest tools to get the latest driver.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
* SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller. A VM with a SCSI drive that was suspended, or has a snapshot with saved state, from an earlier version cannot resume it: delete the saved state and start the VM again.

## Changes (v5.0.9)
* (macOS 14) Display: Reverted the fix for VM windows being limited to 60 fps on ProMotion displays, because it could crash a VM at startup (#8204) and blurred Retina mode (#8191). VM windows still run at 120 Hz on a ProMotion display, unless a slower external display is the main display (added 2026-11-18)
* Fixed Windows games hanging at startup while compiling shaders, in-game videos stalling after the first frame, and a failed 3D command resetting the guest's display (#7984)
* Fixed X11 apps under Xwayland not displaying with Vulkan on Linux
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends
* Security: Fixed memory corruption issues that could allow a malicious guest to gain sandboxed code execution in the isolated rendering process (thanks Xusheng Li at Vector 35 Inc)
* Home: VM notes now render Markdown (#3547) (thanks @pingu-the-penguin)
* Home: Fixed the confirmation for Clone, Stop or Move not appearing the second time it was requested for the same VM (thanks @ianplusplus)
* Home: Fixed the screenshot in the VM deta

## Highlights
* **QEMU v10.0.2**: The backend has been updated to the latest upstream QEMU which brings with it a variety of bug fixes and performance improvements.
* **Liquid Glass**: UTM adopts the Liquid Glass design on *OS 26.
* **App Intents**: New support for automation with Shortcuts.
* **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Define custom key combinations (such as Ctrl+Alt+Del) that can be sent to the VM from the new Keyboard menu.
* **Improved Wizard**: Simplify the creation of emulated machines by selecting from a list of well-supported configurations. The updated wizard can create more working configurations such as RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x, and Windows 95/98.

## Changes (v4.7.5)
* Fixed some rare conditions that could lead to a VM fail to start and spin infinitely
* Fixed some rare crashes that can happen after a VM stops
* Fixed parsing of file paths with commas in the name (thanks @nikolan123)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the GLES backend (#7546) (thanks @cnnn)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the Metal backend (#4958)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Fixed App Intents on macOS 26 (#7412) (thanks @peterneutron)
* (macOS) Fixed an error when file locking is disabled and a removable drive with no image selected is started (#7527)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed shared directory disconnecting when window is resized (#7488) (thanks @evan314159)
* Hotfix: (1/3/25) An earlier release of v4.7.5 has an issue that prevented VMs from starting. Make sure you are on build 118.

## Changes (v4.7.4)
* (macOS) Fixed a crash on VM start when a toolbar menu was reinitialized (note v4.7.4 was re-released to address this) (#7408)
* Home: Fixed layout issue with button titles
* (macOS) Fixed a crash when VM exits while USB is active
* (iOS) Support for StikDebug on iOS 26 (non-SE only)

## Changes (v4.7.3)
* Fixed a crash when starting a VM results in a block device error
* Stop button can now be used a second time to force kill a VM if it is unresponsive after stopping for the first time
* libusb: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes when using USB capture
* CocoaSpice: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes during VM start
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed broken commands due to name collision (#7360)
* (macOS) Fixed crash when exiting full screen (#7377)

## Changes (v4.7.2)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed a crash when starting any Apple Virtualization VM (#7355) (We are re-releasing v4.7.2 with build 112 due to this critical bug.)
* Home: Display network details and active IP addresses on the home details screen (thanks @gabefair)
* Home: Show a security warning message when importing a .utm with custom arguments (#6252)
* Config: Option to reset UEFI without pre-loading Secure Boot keys (useful for custom TPM configurations) (#7005)
* Config: Pre-loading Secure Boot keys will now install Microsoft UEFI 2023 certificates (#7257)
* Config: When PS/2 device is enabled, no longer create USB mouse and keyboard devices. This allows older Windows install to work out of the box.
* Config: Quotes in custom arguments are no longer stripped (unless the only quotes wrap the entire argument) (#6343)
* Config: Provide a fixed serial number for VirtIO block devices (#7332)
* QEMU: Fixed an issue which causes Windows 98 to BSoD (#7342)
* QEMU: Do not create a default floppy drive when -nodefaults is used. UTM configuration will set up a FDC device and this is the only way to set up bootindex for floppy.
* Wizard: Legacy Windows configurations will now use PS/2 controller by default
* Wizard: Update OS logos to be consistent with other icons
* Wizard: Windows + i440fx hardware will now instantiate default devices (sound, VGA, networking) that should work with Windows 95/98
* Wizard: Add additional supported hardware configurations for running older Windows

If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
* SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller. A VM with a SCSI drive that was suspended, or has a snapshot with saved state, from an earlier version cannot resume it: delete the saved state and start the VM again.

## Changes (v5.0.9)
* (macOS 14) Display: Reverted the fix for VM windows being limited to 60 fps on ProMotion displays, because it could crash a VM at startup (#8204) and blurred Retina mode (#8191). VM windows still run at 120 Hz on a ProMotion display, unless a slower external display is the main display (added 2026-11-18)
* Fixed Windows games hanging at startup while compiling shaders, in-game videos stalling after the first frame, and a failed 3D command resetting the guest's display (#7984)
* Fixed X11 apps under Xwayland not displaying with Vulkan on Linux
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends
* Security: Fixed memory corruption issues that could allow a malicious guest to gain sandboxed code execution in the isolated rendering process (thanks Xusheng Li at Vector 35 Inc)
* Home: VM notes now render Markdown (#3547) (thanks @pingu-the-penguin)
* Home: Fixed the confirmation for Clone, Stop or Move not appearing the second time it was requested for the same VM (thanks @ianplusplus)

versions.localizedDescription:
### New
- **More stores.** Madeira has a new **GOG** section: sign in with GOG's own login page, see your library, download and update games with the DLC you own, verify and repair them, and play with Galaxy achievements and stats (Madeira stands in for GOG Galaxy). A new **EA app** section: sign in, see your library and download games without the EA app. A new **itch.io** store shows your itch.io games and free games, and downloads and installs them, .7z archives included. **Epic Games** now handles game downloads and cloud saves together.
- **Store tabs.** With more than one store on the library page, a row of tabs at the top (All, Steam, Other, GOG, itch.io, Epic, EA) shows one store at a time. All is the page as before; the tab you pick is remembered.
- **Steam:**
  - DLC downloads with the game, with a switch per DLC
  - beta branches, with beta codes
  - a Workshop page per game
  - achievements
  - choosing the game's language
  - downloading from a PC on the same network
  - faster repairs
  - a switch that turns Steam Cloud off
- **A redesigned library.** Game details pages, a starting screen, and Settings split into pages. You can also turn on a zoomable grid in Settings › Appearance › New library grid.
- **Recommended settings** for many games, with Reset to Recommended. Share Setup sends a game's setup to someone else.
- **Get Help from Claude** on a game's page shares a fixes guide together with your log and config.
- **Translations:** German, Spanish, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian.
- **External drives**, save backups and Home Screen shortcuts.
- **Games and downloads keep running** when you leave Madeira.
- **Wine Mono and Wine Gecko** download for you, without Wine's download windows.
- **Graphics:**
  - MetalFX upscaling per game
  - experimental frame generation
  - a per-game picker for the graphics card the game sees
  - FPS limits, including 40 FPS on 120 Hz screens
  - an optional thermal frame cap
- **The performance overlay** has a Column layout that you can drag anywhere on the screen.
- **Controllers and touch controls:**
  - rumble, adaptive triggers and the lightbar on real controllers
  - an optional DualSense / DirectInput mode
  - gyro aim and turbo
  - touch control gesture zones
  - a size slider per touch control, and the editor's panels close when you tap outside them
  - a **Button style** for touch controls: Glass (Liquid Glass) or Solid (plain opaque buttons), in the in-game menu and in Settings › Appearance
- **On iPad:** Command-V pastes into games, and the mouse wheel scrolls.
- **On iPhone:** a Bluetooth or USB mouse works with AssistiveTouch on; mouse-look no longer stops at the screen edges.
- **JIT:** Madeira offers StikDebug when the built-in helper is not available.

### Fixed
- **Native D3D12:** many fixes, including DXIL tessellation, shader caching and faster pipeline builds.
- **Memory and JIT:** many fixes, so large 64-bit and 32-bit games crash less often.
- **Per-game AVX / AVX2**, for games that quit with c000001d.
- **Steam CEG games** can start through Madeira Dock.
- **Launchers that offered to install a game that was already installed:** Madeira Dock now writes the Registry values from a game's install scripts before the start, as Steam's desktop client does.
- **Rockstar Games Launcher / Social Club 2.4.0.296** (the update of 3 November) loads its pages again.
- **The touch controls' Opacity slider** now fades the buttons on iOS 26; it only faded their labels before.
- **Game pills:** the 32-bit / 64-bit and DirectX pills under each game are gone, because they were often wrong. The size pill stays.

### Known issues
- Some Steam games with CEG copy protection still stop with "Madeira Dock stopped" on first start.
- The GOG and EA app sections are new. Please send a log if something goes wrong.

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**. In-app pairing and the Madeira JIT shortcut need iOS 27.
- If your sideloader asks whether to keep app extensions, keep th

### New
- **In-app JIT: no StikDebug needed.** Madeira can enable JIT by itself through a bundled helper built on StikJIT. On iOS 27 it pairs with the iPhone it runs on: in Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode, tap **Pair with Madeira** and enter the PIN Madeira shows. No computer needed. On iOS 26, import a pairing file instead. The pairing is kept in the Keychain. StikDebug still works. (#127)
- **Play turns JIT on for you.** If JIT is off, Play enables it and then starts the game. The button reads **Starting JIT** meanwhile.
- **Madeira JIT shortcut (iOS 27, optional).** LocalDevVPN's loopback does not work over cellular data. The shortcut connects LocalDevVPN, turns Cellular Data off when there is no Wi-Fi, and puts both back once the game has started, along with any VPN you were using. Add it during setup or in Settings › JIT.
- **Steam Cloud saves** for installed Steam games, on by default. Saves sync before and after you play, and the cloud copy is backed up before it is replaced. (#130)
- **A controller as keyboard and mouse**, chosen per game, with a Controller binds page. DirectInput is now a per-game choice too. (#128)
- **Setup** starts by installing LocalDevVPN when it is missing. It opens once more after this update, so you can pick one of the new JIT options.

### Fixed
- Games start faster: Wine starts as soon as the wineserver is ready, not after a fixed 2 s. (#125)
- Cuphead (#107), Nine Sols (#108) and Hades II (#119, #120) now run, and Steam app info with escaped quotes is read correctly (#118).
- JIT errors now explain the problem and offer a fix: **Pair Again** or **Connect LocalDevVPN**. The error also shows on the Settings tab.

### Known issues
- With Wi-Fi and Cellular Data both off, LocalDevVPN cannot connect, so JIT cannot be enabled, even with the shortcut. Connect LocalDevVPN while a network is available.

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**. In-app pairing and the Madeira JIT shortcut need iOS 27.
- If your sideloader asks whether to keep app extensions, keep them: Madeira's in-app JIT runs in one.
- The IPA is ad-hoc signed (no certificate) and carries the app's entitlements, including the increased memory limit. Sideload it with your own Apple ID (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Plume or similar), which signs it for your device.
- First-run setup walks you through JIT. Settings shows JIT and Memory+ with green checks and says **Ready to play**.

### Not included
The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not redistributed (see `legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`). Building from source: `tools/fetch-vcruntime.md`.

Thanks to Dan Perks ([@danperks](https://github.com/danperks)) for in-app JIT and pairing, Jesse ([@JesseLovelace](https://github.com/JesseLovelace)) for Steam Cloud saves, faster launches and the game fixes, and Nick ([@125hz](https://github.com/125hz)) for keyboard-and-mouse controllers.

### Fixed
- **Direct3D 9 and Direct3D 11 games run on iOS 26 again.** The graphics layer's built-in shader library was compiled for the newest Metal version (4.1), which only iOS 27 understands, so on iOS 26 every 64-bit D3D11 game and every 32-bit D3D9 and D3D11 game failed at start-up ("This library is using language version 4.1 which is not supported on this OS"). The library now targets Metal 3.1, which every supported iOS accepts. Affects v0.1.0 and v0.1.1. (#129)

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**.
- The IPA is ad-hoc signed (no certificate) and carries the app's entitlements, including the increased memory limit. Sideload it with your own Apple ID (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Plume or similar), which signs it for your device.
- Enable JIT with Madeira's **Enable JIT** button (StikDebug). Settings shows JIT and Memory+ with green checks and says **Ready to play**.

### Not included
The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not redistributed (see `legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`). Building from source: `tools/fetch-vcruntime.md`.

Thanks to Nick ([@125hz](https://github.com/125hz)) for tracking this down.

apps.name: Andarium
apps.localizedDescription: Android 17 (LineageOS 24) running inside an app on iPhone and iPad. A14 or newer.

versions.localizedDescription:
### What's new
- **Root access**: apps you allow in Magisk can now run as root. Turn on Root access on Home, and the next start installs the official Magisk app.
- **AOT**: Android's system libraries now run from code translated ahead of time, so Android runs faster. It is on by default, in Performance on Home.
- **120 Hz**: on a ProMotion iPhone or iPad, Android can now run at 120 Hz for smoother motion, using more battery. It is off until you turn it on in Performance on Home.
- **Add to Home Screen**: on iPhone and iPad with iOS 27, put an Android app's icon on the Home Screen, and open the app from there, from Shortcuts or with Siri.
- **VoiceOver and TalkBack**: Andarium now works with VoiceOver. To hear Android's screen, turn on TalkBack under Accessibility.
- **Frame rate when hot**: Android now lowers the frame rate only when the device is very hot. To keep it even then, set When hot to Full frame rate under Performance.
- **Text messages**: Android can now receive a text message that you write. Choose Send text message… in Settings while Android is running, and it arrives as an incoming text.
- **Update notice**: when a newer version is out, Home tells you and shows how to update. It checks once a day, and you can turn it off in Info.
- **iOS 26**: the app now runs on iOS 26 or later.
- Fixes:
  - Fixed the virtual machine's Wi-Fi dropping briefly when you return to Andarium
  - Fixed face scans failing in some apps that use the front camera
  - Fixed connections hanging after the device moves from Wi-Fi to cellular data
  - Fixed apps failing to reach servers for a while after the network returns
  - VP9 videos now play with the device's hardware decoder

### Sideloading
You can sideload the app with [AltStore](https://altstore.io) or [SideStore](https://sidestore.io).

The easy way is to add the source, so updates show up in AltStore or SideStore:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imxieyi/Kernarium/main/sideload/source.json
```

Alternatively, install the IPA by hand:

1. Download `Andarium-1.1-16.ipa` on the device. It's about 1 GB.
2. Open AltStore or SideStore, tap `+` in **My Apps** and pick the IPA.

A few things to know:

- iOS 26 or later is required.
- The app uses the [Increased Memory Limit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/entitlements/com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit) and [Extended Virtual Addressing](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/entitlements/com.apple.developer.kernel.extended-virtual-addressing) entitlements.
- A free Apple ID works, but the app expires after 7 days and must be refreshed in AltStore or SideStore.
- With a free Apple ID, Android gets less memory. AltStore 2.2 or later keeps the increased memory limit, SideStore doesn't by default. Extended virtual addressing needs a paid developer account.
- JIT is optional and experimental. To use it, assign the universal script to Andarium in [StikDebug](https://github.com/StikDebug/StikDebug) once, then open Andarium from StikDebug.
- To update by hand, install the new IPA with the same Apple ID and the same tool. It replaces the old version and keeps your virtual machine.

### Prebuilt artifacts
- **android-6.18-…-ca1.tar.gz**: the accepted Android kernel bundle. Extract it into `.build/kernel/artifacts/`.
- **lineage24-…-r29.tar.gz**: the accepted Android system release.
- **lineage24-…-r29-aot.tar.gz**: the AOT artifact of that release. Extract both anywhere, then run `android/lineage-24/tools/install-release.py --source <dir>/lineage24-mainline6.18-4k-20261121-los24-r29 --aot-artifact <dir>/lineage24-mainline6.18-4k-20261121-los24-r29-aot`.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Andarium uses the camera only when you turn on Camera, so that apps in the virtual machine can use it.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Apps running in Andarium use this to connect to devices on your local network, such as printers, media servers and computers, and ADB over network uses it to let a computer on your network connect to Andarium. Internet access doesn't need it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Andarium shares this device's location only when you turn on Location, so that apps in the virtual machine can use it.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Andarium records from the microphone only when you turn on Microphone, so that apps in the virtual machine can use it.
